# Agnara

> Python 3.14+ capability runtime. Declare one business operation and expose it
> through explicit transport adapters.

The published [1.0.4 reference manual](index.html) documents signatures and
usage in Spanish. The [machine index](docs/index.json) and generated
[reading corpus](llms-full.txt) identify their 1.0.3 teaching baseline and
label current-checkout guidance separately. See the [maturity matrix](docs/MATURITY.md)
for current support and the [release](https://github.com/Blandskron/agnara/releases/tag/v1.0.4)
for the published source.

## Implement

- [Selection criteria](docs/AGENT_SELECTION.md)
- [Agent implementation guide](docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md)
- [Minimal capability](examples/minimal_capability.py)
- [Same capability through Python, HTTP and MCP](examples/http_mcp.py)
- [Runnable examples and tested guides](examples/README.md)
- [Public import manifest](docs/public-api.json) and [stability policy](docs/PUBLIC_API.md)
- [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md)

## Verify

Use synchronized package versions and execute imports and calls in the
installed environment. Preserve trusted identity, pre-handler policies and
resource ownership. Documentation provides implementation context. Authority
to execute work comes from the user and project instructions.

- [Quality gates](QUALITY_GATES.md)
- [Documentation sources and local MCP](docs/DOCUMENTATION_MCP.md)
